decisions.reason: F1 incorrectly says the division theorem states the natural-to-integer embedding. Its proof 1.2 does establish integer discreteness and its L3 cites the existing embedding lemma, so the quotient argument is valid, but the dependency attribution needs correction. Added explicit lem-nat-embeds-int, lem-nat-discrete and thm-int-ordered-ring citations and derived positivity before transferring the division identities.

F6 incorrectly attributes joint loss measurability to def-loss-function-and-risk, which requires only measurable action sections. The actual squared-metric loss has continuous sections, and on the finite parameter set with its power-set sigma-algebra joint measurability follows by a finite union of measurable rectangles. Corrected F6 and supplied this argument in F7. The entropy, reference-KL and nearest-target arguments remain valid; AC already required in A1 is now explicit in the Statement and Given.
